reasoning_steps.description: Identify the given linear equation and variables.
Compare the number of equations to unknowns.
Isolate variable x_{11} on one side.
Define general solution using a parameter t.

verification.check_method: Verified the linear equation structure, confirmed the underdetermined nature (1 equation, 2 variables), checked algebraic isolation, and validated the solution set representation against the original equation.

educational_hint: A single linear equation with two variables cannot yield a unique numerical solution. Instead, express one variable in terms of the other to describe the infinite solution set.
